name: Jetstream2 LLM Service
description: NSF-funded cloud with a small open-model inference service.
overview: Jetstream2, the NSF-funded research cloud, runs a small LLM inference service for Llama and GPT-OSS models. The terms exclude AI training and data mining on user data, but chat history exists and administrators may inspect interactions for acceptable-use enforcement.
free_access: Free for US research and education
notes: Administrators can inspect interactions for acceptable-use enforcement.
